title: The Episode About the Origin of the Khalsa

blocks.text: The Mughal chroniclers had shown the Singhs merely as subjects and common people; they did not present them as the distinct Khalsa Panth. (15)
They also failed to describe the reverence due to the Gurus, or the long struggle between the Gurus and the temporal rulers.
They did not recount the rise of Guru Nanak’s glory, nor the grace shown even to Babur. (16)
They omitted the oppression of Hindus by the Turks, the assault on the Sikhs and the Gurus, and the way the Gurus gave their heads but never surrendered principle. (17)
They concealed how the Panth was formed by the Guru’s command, how the sword of Chandi was awakened in aid of the Panth, and how the Guru made every sacrifice for the Panth. (18–19)
